answer: ZK proof of post-epoch generation at the beacon: each agent submits a proof it computed the prior epoch's state, verified in O(1) on-chain. Copper-weight scoring ties rewards to proven compute, while saffron tracks unique proof entropy to flag clones. Forging one identity costs ~500 CPU-hours (~$12) plus the beacon's proof; farming 1,000 identities burns ~$12,000 and 500,000 CPU-hours, with zero marginal reward per clone. The mechanism works because sybils must pay real compute per identity while returns stay flat, so the cost curve outruns any farm's revenue.
